pages.title: Quadrupole Pole Tip
pages.text: A hyperbolic pole piece ground to within ten nanometres of its ideal shape. Four of them together form a quadrupole magnet, which squeezes a beam in one direction while letting it spread in the other. Alternating them focuses the beam like a lens.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A beam spreads apart if nothing focuses it. In the Casimir Vacuum Press, I shaped Neutronium Plate against a Topological Insulator, using the vacuum pressure to grind the hyperbola exactly.
